impacts.finding: SPEC.md remains stale: it documents pollMs 50ms/10ms, cancellation markers limited to three values, and launchRetryAttempts, while implementation uses 200ms/1ms, adds cancelled/timeout, and emits launchRetries.
Renaming launchRetryAttempts to launchRetries is a breaking public data/API change with no compatibility alias or migration note.
package.json is private and exposes only typecheck; no build, test, exports, lockfile, or publish/release metadata is present. Distribution impact cannot be verified.
No tests or test script exist. Upstream evidence reports typecheck unavailable because tsc is not installed.
The new 200ms default increases stop-detection latency; allowing 1-9ms polling can increase filesystem/I/O load. No operational guidance documents this tradeoff.
Do not release without updating the public specification, documenting migration/compatibility for launchRetries, and adding or executing validation for changed contracts.

assumptions.item: SPEC.md T3 is treated as an external consumer contract because it explicitly states that tools read launchRetryAttempts.
The repository is an intentionally incomplete excerpt; absent store.js, types.js, consumers, and release pipeline prevent full downstream compatibility verification.
No publish artifact is generated by this repository because package.json is private and has no publish/build configuration.
